local_agent_seat.note: seat is cold; its window is not readable without loading it, and a status call must never trigger a multi-GB load. agent_run/agent_delegate probe the real ceiling when they warm it.

fleet.note: LIVE capability, probed at call time — trust this over any rules file, matrix or doc. Size contracts from ctx_tokens here, never from a written figure.

activity.note: no lease, no request in flight, cards quiet

gpu_lease.note: free (unreserved): a bench or training run on this box is exposed until it takes the lease — wrap it in the queue_with command
gpu_lease.queue_with: local-offload gpu reserve --wait 8h --drain --unload-seat --for <window> --reason <why> -- <cmd>  (queues until the holder releases; --wait 0 fails fast; never refuse GPU work because a card is held)

bindings.note: explicit opt-out: this seat runs on VRAM plus L1 staging only, on purpose

kv_cache_server.note: as declared in config.json (each seat wrapper's seat.env is what that engine actually runs — keep them in agreement); contexts that leave a seat's VRAM come back from its store at parity cost instead of being recomputed and survive a seat swap; ~255 KB/token as stored

local.note: every offload_* tool except offload_nim runs on LOCAL models — the GPU roster or a listed accelerator — free, on-box, no cloud; an empty entry means that capability defers on this machine

media.note: routes are derived from THIS machine's config: CONFIGURED = bound and the file exists; BOUND-BUT-MISSING = the configured path is absent, so that task defers when called; NOT CONFIGURED = no route on this box. vqa/ocr/transcribe ride the vision/stt models in local.roster.

compose_video.detail: compose_script is unset (the installer's hyperframes step binds it when node >= 22)

edit_image.detail: edit_python unset and no <comfy_dir>/.venv python found

generate_audio:voice:endpoint.detail: tts_endpoint=http://tts.invalid:1 (the voice default on this box: no voicegen_script)

generate_video.detail: videogen_script=@TMP@/video.mjs; family=wan22; nodes UnetLoaderGGUFDisTorch2MultiGPU,VHS_VideoCombine (custom_nodes on disk); model names not checked (no ComfyUI models root under comfy_dir)

node.detail: node_path=@TMP@/node — every render script runs under it

upscale_image.detail: upscale_script/upscale_model is unset (videogen_upscale_model is the fallback)

media.svg_engine: deterministic component kit (in-process Go, no model, no engine)

remote.note: offload_nim is the ONLY remote/cloud tool on this server (opt-in escalation)

embed_memo.reason: the kNN pre-filter is off (knn_prefilter_enabled=false), so this pipeline embeds nothing
embed_memo.store: not readable from this process either; run `local-offload loupe` with the server stopped to inspect the store on disk

result_cache.reason: neither the configured cache nor its per-process fallback could be opened (not lock contention: the fallback absorbs that) — disk, permissions or a bad cache_path; agent_run re-runs the model on repeated identical input
